verdict.rationale: The privacy axis applies to a cloud platform that offers AI services such as Bedrock. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes an opt-out, AI-services opt-out policy, or a guarantee that customer data is not used for model training. Bedrock and AgentCore evidence covers model access and security in general, not training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
